'''Fruit fizz''' was a [[Fruit/Legends|fruity]] beverage served by [[Bartender/Legends|bartenders]] in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
[[Fruit/Legends|Fruit]] fizz had a [[brown]]ish [[Color/Legends|coloration]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Fruit/Legends|Fruit]] fizz appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. In the game, fruit fizz could be purchased from [[Bartender/Legends|bartenders]] in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It should be noted that the same graphical model for fruit fizz was used for other items in the game, such as [[Jawa beer]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
